author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: an awareness ribbon (rounded loop over two crossing tails) framed by two open butterfly wings, each arcing from near the centre over the top corner, down to a waist notch and a smaller lower lobe; mirrored about x=24 and reads as a butterfly with the ribbon as its body. Two earlier candidates with a tall ribbon and small side wings read as brace/letter glyphs and were rejected. The rejected drawing fused the wings to the ribbon in one heavy outline.
omissions: The ribbon is drawn as a single-stroke ribbon (no double-edged band or angled tail cuts), and the ribbon is shorter than in the reference so the wings can arc over it with 8 units of clearance.
drawing_plan: Mirrored about x=24: strands (20,40)-(28,24) and (20,24)-(28,40) crossing at (24,32), loop cubic crest y=17; wings open cubic runs from (18,10) over (12,8) to (4,16), waist (9,25), lobe (4,32), end (11,38).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'ribbon' (crossing strands with a rounded loop) and 'butterfly' (wings as open lobed curves).
